body.purpose: Options/library body and control text (popup uses 12px).

overline.purpose: Uppercase sidebar group labels and reader rail section heads.

prose.purpose: Reader body; user-steppable size, leading, measure.

shadows.name: switch-thumb
shadows.purpose: Switch thumb edge; only resting-control shadow.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Soft Fill button: filled, border collapsed into fill, instant press.
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;height:32px;padding:0 12px;font:400 14px/30px "Helvetica Neue", Verdana, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;color:#000;background:#eaeae5;border:1px solid #eaeae5;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms,border-color 150ms,box-shadow 150ms} .ds-btn:hover{background:#dfdfdf;border-color:#dfdfdf} .ds-btn:active{transform:scale(0.97)} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:#5d88c2;box-shadow:0 0 6px 1px color-mix(in srgb,#4477bb 45%,transparent)}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Bookmark Blue primary action; one per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:32px;padding:0 12px;font:600 14px/30px "Helvetica Neue", Verdana, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;color:#fff;background:#4477bb;border:1px solid #4477bb;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms,box-shadow 150ms} .ds-btn-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,#4477bb 88%,#333)} .ds-btn-primary:active{transform:scale(0.97)} .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:#5d88c2;box-shadow:0 0 6px 1px color-mix(in srgb,#4477bb 45%,transparent)}

components.name: Quiet Danger Button
components.description: Quiet danger tier: danger text on normal fill; solid tier lives only in the confirm bubble.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:32px;padding:0 12px;font:400 14px/30px "Helvetica Neue", Verdana, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;color:#cc0000;background:#eaeae5;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,#cc0000 55%,#858585);border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms} .ds-btn-danger:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,#cc0000 8%,#eaeae5)} .ds-btn-danger:active{transform:scale(0.97)} .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible{outline:1px solid #4477bb;outline-offset:2px;box-shadow:0 0 6px 1px color-mix(in srgb,#4477bb 45%,transparent)}

components.name: Soft Fill Field
components.description: Filled text field; no visible border at rest; fill unchanged on focus.
components.css: .ds-field{height:32px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:4px 8px;font:400 14px/20px "Helvetica Neue", Verdana, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;color:#333;background:#eaeaea;border:1px solid #eaeaea;border-radius:8px;min-width:240px;transition:background-color 150ms,border-color 150ms,box-shadow 150ms} .ds-field::placeholder{color:#616161} .ds-field:hover{background:#dfdfdf;border-color:#dfdfdf} .ds-field:focus{outline:none;border-color:#5d88c2} .ds-field:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 6px 1px color-mix(in srgb,#4477bb 45%,transparent)}

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Full pill; selected state uses chip wash at weight 600.
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:2px 10px;font:400 12px/14px "Helvetica Neue", Verdana, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;color:#333;background:#eaeae5;border-radius:9999px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms} .ds-chip:hover{background:#dfdfdf} .ds-chip.is-on{background:#e8edf4;font-weight:600} .ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:1px solid #4477bb;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Switch
components.description: 28×16 borderless track; whole row is the hit area.
components.css: .ds-switch{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:20px;width:260px;font:400 14px/20px "Helvetica Neue", Verdana, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;color:#333;cursor:pointer} .ds-switch input{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;margin:0;cursor:pointer} .ds-switch i{margin-left:auto;position:relative;width:28px;height:16px;border-radius:9999px;background:#858585;transition:background-color 150ms} .ds-switch i::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.28),0 0 0 .5px rgba(0,0,0,.06);transition:transform 150ms} .ds-switch input:checked~i{background:#4477bb} .ds-switch input:checked~i::before{transform:translateX(12px)} .ds-switch input:focus-visible~i{outline:1px solid #4477bb;outline-offset:2px;box-shadow:0 0 6px 1px color-mix(in srgb,#4477bb 45%,transparent)}

components.name: Sidebar Nav
components.description: Options sidebar: muted text rows with a 2px left edge; active row is ink, 600, filled.
components.html:
General
AccountAIReader
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:180px;font-family:"Helvetica Neue", Verdana, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif} .ds-nav-group{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;color:#666;padding:12px 12px 4px} .ds-nav-item{display:flex;align-items:center;height:32px;padding:0 12px;font-size:13px;color:#666;text-decoration:none;border-left:2px solid transparent;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;transition:color 150ms,background-color 150ms} .ds-nav-item:hover{color:#333;background:rgba(0,0,0,.03);border-left-color:#bbb} .ds-nav-item.is-active{color:#333;font-weight:600;background:rgba(0,0,0,.05);border-left-color:#333} .ds-nav-item:focus-visible{outline:1px solid #4477bb;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Confirm Bubble
components.description: Anchored danger confirmation; solid danger 'yes' is the only solid-danger control.
components.css: .ds-confirm{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;padding:4px 8px;font:700 11px/14px "Helvetica Neue", Verdana, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;color:#cc0000;background:#fff;border:1px solid #858585;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08),0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.04)} .ds-confirm button{padding:2px 8px;font:inherit;border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer} .ds-yes{background:#cc0000;color:#fff;border:1px solid #cc0000} .ds-yes:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #fff} .ds-no{background:transparent;color:#333;border:1px solid #858585} .ds-no:hover{background:#dfdfdf} .ds-confirm button:active{transform:scale(0.97)} .ds-confirm button:focus-visible{outline:1px solid #4477bb;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Library Index Row
components.description: Borderless row: highlight dot + 2-line excerpt + meta; state by background only.
components.css: .ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:10px 1fr;column-gap:12px;width:360px;padding:8px 12px;text-align:left;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:8px;font-family:"Helvetica Neue", Verdana, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;color:#1a1a2e;cursor:pointer} .ds-row:hover{background:#ececee} .ds-row:active{background:#e0e0e3} .ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3e88e9;outline-offset:-2px} .ds-dot{width:10px;height:10px;margin-top:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#facc15} .ds-ex{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;font-size:14px;line-height:20px} .ds-meta{display:block;font-size:12px;line-height:16px;color:#5f6368}

narrative.overview:
This UI is a well-kept tool drawer. Every control sits in a known slot at a known size, gives instant feedback, and gets out of the way. Quality is not shown through decoration. It shows in alignment that holds to the pixel, contrast that clears AA on every theme, and a response that is already finished by the time the finger lifts. The user opens the popup dozens of times a day on a 4K Windows machine, so the system favors calm, dense, predictable surfaces over expressive ones.

The default theme is a **neutral skeleton**. Its light side is a warm off-white canvas with soft gray fills and one Bookmark Blue accent. Its dark side is Warm Ink: Flexoki's warm black with paper-colored text, never a cold blue-gray. Personality is delegated to 14 named presets (Dracula, Nord Night, Catppuccin, Solarized, Terminal, and others), all generated by the theme factory from the same role tokens. A preset may change color, radius, and focus-ring shape, but it never changes geometry, density outside the two allowed rungs, or interaction language.

The reader (md-preview) and the notes and vocabulary page (library) lean **warm and readable**: paper-like canvases, a generous prose measure, and structure carried by type scale and whitespace instead of boxes. The popup and options pages lean **compact and efficient**: label columns, a strict control-height ladder, and dense rows.
keyCharacteristics: Flat by default. Shadows belong only to things that float (popovers, listbox menus, confirm bubbles, toasts).
Soft Fill controls: filled, never outlined at rest; instant press; one soft focus glow.
One accent, used for primary action, selection, focus, and links, and nothing decorative.

Tokens per surface (`--pp-*` popup, `--opt-*` options, `--lib-*` library, unprefixed in the reader), all generated by `docs/theme-surface/`. The frontmatter records the **options** surface's default light values as the canonical reference, plus key dark (Warm Ink) values.
Fast-font discipline: explicit CJK stacks, named monospace first, no emoji glyphs anywhere in UI.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Bookmark Blue is the only chromatic accent in the chrome. It marks action, selection, focus, and links, and is never decoration, illustration, or section color.

rules.name: The Derived, Not Picked Rule
rules.body: Every text/fill pair is derived to WCAG AA (4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI parts) by the theme factory, and focus cores are derived from the accent to at least 3:1. Never hand-pick a hex in a consuming rule. Edit composers or pilots, then run `sync-all`.

rules.name: The Weak Text Rule
rules.body: Hint, muted, and link text never sit on a control fill. Controls use their own AA-derived `btn-fg-muted`.

rules.name: The Fast Fallback Rule
rules.body: Every UI font stack names fast CJK families before `sans-serif`, and every mono stack names a real mono font first and CJK before `monospace`. `button, input, select` always `font-family: inherit`. A fallback to a slow font freezes cold first paint on high-DPI Windows for 1–3s.

rules.name: The Two Rungs Rule
rules.body: Density has exactly two rungs, comfortable and compact (only Terminal and Gruvbox Dark use compact). Themes never define their own type sizes.

rules.name: The Relationship Owns the Space Rule
rules.body: Gaps belong to the relationship between elements (action-row gap 8, cluster gap 4, field rhythm), not to the elements themselves. Surface HTML never carries inline margin, padding, or gap.

rules.name: The Flat Canvas Rule
rules.body: On a canvas (especially library), regions are separated by type scale, whitespace, column alignment, hanging labels, and small section heads. No cards, color blocks, inset wells, or divider lines. Floating layers are the only exception (user ruling, 2026-10-03).

dos: **Do** take every color, radius, and focus ring from the surface's tokens with bare `var(--ns-x)` and no fallback, and change them only through `docs/theme-surface/` composers and pilots followed by `node docs/theme-surface/tools/sync-all.mjs`.
**Do** keep controls on the ladder: 32/28px (options and library), 26/20px (popup and reader), at least 24px for every icon hit area, and at least 44px for options preference rows.
**Do** press with `scale(0.97)` (buttons) or a deeper background (whole rows), instantly. Transitions list properties explicitly and stay at 200ms or less (150ms for state changes).
**Do** use one of three focus placements: bordered (fields, `.btn`), borderless (1px accent outline + glow for links, tabs, chips, and switches), or inset (2px for rows and segment cells).
**Do** use Lucide v0.525.0 paths at stroke 2 inside a 24 box for every icon. Give icon-only buttons a `title`, an `aria-label`, and a 24px hit area.
**Do** separate canvas regions with type, whitespace, and alignment.
donts: **Don't** draw color blocks, cards, inset wells, or divider lines to section a flat canvas (library), and don't go above hairline weight for section edges on options panels.
**Don't** outline controls at rest or change a field's fill on focus.
**Don't** add shadows to resting surfaces. Shadows are for floating layers only.
**Don't** use literal emoji or dingbats (⚠ ✓ ✗ ✕ ↻ ▸ ▾ ℹ) in UI. `×` (U+00D7) is the only literal symbol allowed.
**Don't** lead a mono stack with `ui-monospace` or bare `monospace`, or omit fast CJK families from any UI stack.
**Don't** use `transition: all`, add first-paint entrance animations, load remote fonts, or ship any runtime dependency.
**Don't** open overlays on hover in the reader, and don't apply the 14 presets to the reader.
**Don't** hand-edit `pinboard-themes.js` or any `@generated:*` region in popup.css, options.css, or library.css.
**Don't** set hint, muted, or link-colored text on a control fill.
